scheme_name: PM-YASASVI: Top Class School Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
other_conditions: Must be a student belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC) or Denotified, Nomadic Tribes (DNT)
Must be studying in a Top Class School (public, aided or private) identified under the scheme
Must be studying from Class 9 to Class 12
Must provide all necessary details during application
The school must have an Aadhaar‑Based Attendance System that can be integrated with a central portal
Students receiving this scholarship cannot receive assistance for the same items under any other government scheme
benefits_summary: Scholarship provides up to ₹75,000 per year for classes 9‑10 and up to ₹1,25,000 per year for classes 11‑12 covering tuition, hostel and other school fees.
